players.product: Ultra-fine, high-purity nickel-based powders for MLCC electrodes (volume supply to global MLCC makers); also copper and silver-coated copper powders

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials IR activity record: 2026-009 (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, September 2026 site visits): H1 2026 main-business revenue was RMB 826,638,326.51, up 70.20% year on year. Nickel and copper powders go mainly into MLCC production (consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI hardware) and silver-coated powders mainly into base-metal substitution in photovoltaics; downstream customers are mainly MLCC and other component makers with paste-making capability and paste makers. In H1 2026 domestic substitution of its copper powder in MLCC electronic pastes strengthened further and copper powder shipments for electronic components grew substantially year on year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials IR activity record: 2026-009 (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): Q2 2026 gross margin fell from Q1 for two reasons. Production cost rose - new capacity came on stream in Q2, hiring increased and new staff are still gaining proficiency, and depreciation began on equipment transferred to fixed assets. Product mix changed - high-end MLCC demand is strong, but because Japanese and Korean makers allocate capacity to AI orders first and high-end capacity takes long to expand, supply growth is limited, so incremental purchases of high-end nickel powder were limited and overall high-end nickel powder demand is levelling off; meanwhile mid- and high-capacitance consumer MLCC is moving faster to mainland China and Taiwan, where the volume products are mid-range and mid-to-high-end nickel products with lower gross margins. In H2 it will optimise the mix, speed capacity build and release and cut costs, but it cannot judge the size of the H2 gross-margin change. Management sees MLCC makers' expansion plus AI-server-driven high-capacitance MLCC demand bringing phased demand from core customers' expansion and a structural shift to finer particle sizes.
